title: Three talking points ahead of FC Barcelona vs Real Madrid | La Liga MD 10
tweet: Flick’s line‑up for the Clasico will show whether El Clasico was truly the priority over the midweek PSG game. Real’s counter‑attack threat has risen; a single defensive lapse could change the outcome. A victory would stretch Barça’s lead to nine points early in the season, a cushion that could dictate the title race.

title: Three things Barcelona need to do to beat Real Madrid in El Clasico
tweet: Barcelona must keep the high line but press like animals; only a coordinated first‑press will stop Mbappé and Diomandé. Pedri and Rodri need to dictate tempo and recover quickly to deny Madrid’s rapid transitions. And Yamal and Raphinha must convert the chances they create – clinical finishing is the only gap that can tip the balance.
